name: funder-report
title: Programme delivery evidence pack
for_each: select id,name from programmes order by name

sections.title: Programme
sections.sql: select name,owner,jurisdiction,review_on from programmes where id=$1

sections.title: Delivery totals by benefit
sections.sql: select b.name,b.unit,b.target_units,coalesce(sum(d.units),0) as delivered_units from benefits b left join sessions s on s.benefit_id=b.id left join deliveries d on d.session_id=s.id and d.status='delivered' where b.programme_id=$1 group by b.id order by b.name
sections.note: Different units are never combined. These are recorded outputs, not proof of social outcomes.

sections.title: Reporting milestones
sections.sql: select name,due_on,status,evidence from milestones where programme_id=$1 order by due_on

name: session-register
title: Session reconciliation record
for_each: select id,name from sessions order by name

sections.title: Recorded deliveries
sections.sql: select pt.name as participant,d.units,d.evidence,d.status from deliveries d join enrolments e on e.id=d.enrolment_id join participants pt on pt.id=e.participant_id where d.session_id=$1 order by pt.name
sections.note: Private operator paperwork. Check against the original signed register.

name: retention-review
title: Delivery evidence retention review
for_each: select id,name from programmes order by name

sections.title: Retention dates
sections.sql: select source_id,participant,delivered_on,retain_until,evidence,status from v_delivery_ledger where programme_id=$1 order by retain_until
sections.note: Review statutory, contract and privacy requirements together. This report does not authorise disposal.
